summary: The PR leaves two definitionally identical constructions and two parallel interfaces side by side in the same file: locSubring re-states locBaseSubring's body verbatim and four of its lemmas re-prove the general ones instead of delegating. Since the PR itself shows the bridge is rfl, rebasing locSubring onto locBaseSubring is free and removes the duplication.
